assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and three key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough boundaries (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003), not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics are low-confidence design-model values recomputed in EPSG:4548 from provisional geometry; the full recomputation chain must be rerun when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Existing-condition layers (major roads, rail, waterways, stations, parks, land-use anchors) derive from OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API on 2026-08-23 (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors).
assumptions.impact: Existing conditions guide design alignment only; OSM is never used for formal boundary, precise-area, or planning-control claims. Currency varies and requires official survey or fieldwork verification before formal use.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, floor counts, road-alignment concepts, stitch segments, squares and phasing are conceptual design proposals generated by the agent on the real street skeleton.
assumptions.impact: They express design intent and supply magnitude for discussion; they are not engineering, demolition, or implementation conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The Qinghuayuan Station heritage hint is inferred from public data; its location is corroborated by OSM disused-rail segments near 39.956-39.960 N, but the extent is not a statutory heritage boundary.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-related design moves remain directional until the cultural-relics authority confirms boundaries.
